parsed.rationale: Three distinct blend-mode enums in the same package (`Wallpaper`) — `MaterialBlendMode`, `PlaybackBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — each independently implement a `displayName` property at the same line offset (line 41), which is the canonical signal for a default-implementation candidate. Because all three types live under `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/`, a shared protocol (e.g., `BlendModeDisplayable`) with a protocol extension providing the default `displayName` implementation can be introduced in that same package without any new dependency edges. Each conformer's hand-written implementation can then be deleted, leaving only overrides where the display name genuinely diverges.
